elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The added warranty only states that Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the Agreement; it does not impose a professional-and-workmanlike performance standard.

elements.element: Deliverables other than software conform to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause covers only the Interface, related software, Hosting Services, and Support Services; it does not warrant other deliverables' conformity to documentation.
The clause warrants conformity only 'in all material respects,' permitting non-material nonconformities, whereas the preferred position is unqualified.

elements.element: The software conformity warranty lasts for 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software warranty lasts only 90 days following delivery.

elements.element: The services warranty lasts for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The services warranty lasts only 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the applicable warranty.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client's election, repair non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the applicable warranty.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client's election, replace non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: A refund is available as a remedy for breach of the applicable warranty.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client's election, refund the fees paid for non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: TrueLink warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the operative language.

elements.element: TrueLink warrants that the software and deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious-code warranty appears in the operative language.

elements.element: Software is covered by a warranty for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and all related software are warranted for 90 days following delivery.

elements.element: Services are covered by a warranty for 30 days.
elements.evidence: Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted for 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the software or services warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits Client to elect repair of non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the software or services warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits Client to elect replacement of non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: A refund is available as a remedy for breach of the software or services warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits Client to elect a refund of fees paid for non-conforming software or Services.

result.reason: The operative addition reaches the expressly stated fallback durations and provides each required remedy at Client's election. It does not reach the preferred position because it uses shorter periods, lacks professional-and-workmanlike, legal-compliance, and malicious-code warranties, omits non-software deliverables, and materially qualifies software conformity. The change is confined to the relevant warranties and remedies and does not contradict the existing disclaimer, which already carves out express warranties.
